product.title: Eqqualberry Vitamin Illuminating Cream 50 Ml.
product.description_html:
Dark spots and uneven-looking tone meet targeted care with EQQUALBERRY’s 50 ml illuminating face cream. Its formula combines 5% niacinamide, tranexamic acid, acerola fruit water, 0.5% panthenol, and ceramide NP to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion while caring for moisture-barrier needs.

  • Targets the look of dark spots: Helps brighten the appearance of the skin and promote a more even-looking tone.
  • Supports the moisture barrier: Formulated to strengthen the skin barrier for skin that feels cared for.
  • Helps limit moisture loss: Provides moisture support for dryness concerns.

Apply after toner or serum. Spread over the face and neck, then pat gently to aid absorption. Use morning and evening.

This cream is listed as suitable for all skin types.

100% authentic Korean beauty products, sourced directly from official and authorized suppliers, so you can shop with complete confidence.

Note:

A patch test on a small area of skin is recommended before full use, especially for sensitive skin.
